h1:
15 Popular Stays
in Si Racha, Chonburi
We've Already Reviewed
heroSub: 15 hand-picked Si Racha stays we've reviewed in depth — a seafront resort with a water park and onsen, in-town serviced apartments with kitchens, an authentic Japanese-style hotel, and sea-view rooms along Si Racha bay. Prices start around ฿900–2,100/night.
heroStats: ✅ Honest take from real reviews at every stay
introH2: 🏙️ How many types of Si Racha stays are there, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Si Racha isn't a beach getaway town like Pattaya or Bang Saen, and that's exactly what makes choosing a stay here different — this is an industrial city with estates and the Laem Chabang port, a city with a Japanese community large enough that Japanese restaurants and onsen are scattered all over town, and a seaside city with Koh Loi and a viewpoint bridge over Si Racha bay · Most stays here aren't beachfront resorts but serviced apartments with in-room kitchens, designed for estate workers, long-stayers, and families driving down from Bangkok alike · Plenty of people book a Si Racha stay expecting a sandy beach to swim at, only to arrive and find the sea on this side is more of a viewpoint seawall than a beach · This article rounds up 15 Si Racha stays we've reviewed in depth — seafront resorts with water parks for families, in-town serviced apartments with kitchens, and Japanese-style onsen hotels — every one drawn from reading guests' real reviews, telling you the good and the caveats honestly, with a 3-site price compare and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Si Racha has no train line. Getting around mainly means your own car or Grab · From Bangkok it's about an hour and a half down the motorway, around 50 min from U-Tapao Airport and about an hour from Suvarnabhumi · The main neighborhoods in this article: central Si Racha (Surasak/Jerm Jompon Rd) — walk to Robinson, Pacific Park, Koh Loi, and seafront eateries, good if you don't have a car · Surasak area (Sukhumvit Rd) — near the estates and J-Park Nihon Mura, with onsen and in-room kitchens, good for workers and long stays, mostly needs a car · Si Racha seafront — sea-view rooms over the Gulf, walk to Koh Loi and the viewpoint bridge · Many hotels run a free shuttle van into town, to Pattaya, and to Bang Saen.

entries.name: Centara Sonrisa Residences & Suites Sriracha
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Surasak · Si Racha · seafront with a pier
entries.storyHtml: If we're starting this list with the most family-friendly stay, the reviews point pretty clearly in one direction — Centara Sonrisa Residences & Suites Sriracha is a Centara-group hotel sitting right on the sea in the Surasak area, and it's the most-reviewed stay in this article, with over 1,310 reviews, an Agoda 9.0 and a Booking 8.9 · What makes parents fall for it is the water park, kids' club, and seafront pool that give kids something to do all day without leaving, plus an on-site onsen for grown-ups who want to unwind · Rooms span several tiers from Superior up to a Family Residence with an in-room kitchen, good for families who want to cook for themselves and stay several nights · Service is friendly and up to Centara standard, and the seafront location means bay views and a pier that plenty of guests say photographs beautifully both morning and evening · The drive from Bangkok is close enough for an easy weekend trip · Honest caveats from the reviews: the sea in front is better for taking in the view and photos than for swimming, since it's a pier seawall rather than a sandy beach · Food prices inside the hotel run fairly high compared with eateries outside, and the location is a fair way from in-town restaurants, so it suits people with a car · If you're traveling with little kids and want a stay that handles everything in one place with the kids' activities sorted, this is the one the reviews put near the top in Si Racha.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're bringing kids, pick a Family Residence with a kitchen and more space, and ask about the water park and kids' club opening hours at check-in since there are cleaning windows · An Ocean View room gets you a full-on view of the pier.
pros: Seafront with a water park, kids' club, and onsen — the most family-friendly stay on the list
Most reviews in the article, over 1,310, with an Agoda 9.0
Residence rooms have kitchens, good for several nights · Centara-standard service
Short drive from Bangkok, good for a family weekend trip
cons: The sea in front isn't for swimming — it's a pier seawall for taking in the view (from reviews)
Food prices inside the hotel run fairly high compared with eateries outside
Location is a fair way from in-town restaurants, suits people with a car

entries.type: 4-Star City Hotel & Residence · Attached to a Mall
entries.name: Pacific Park Hotel
entries.badge: 🛍️ Best in-town location · attached to Robinson
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Srirachanakorn 3 Rd · inside Pacific Park mall
entries.storyHtml: If you don't have a car and want everything within walking distance, Pacific Park Hotel is the most on-the-nose answer in Si Racha, because the hotel shares a building with Pacific Park mall and is attached to Robinson Si Racha — take the lift down and you're straight at restaurants, a supermarket, and coffee shops · It's a 4-star hotel-residence with plenty of reviews, over 659, an Agoda 9.0 and a Booking 8.9 · Rooms range from Studio up to a Two Bedroom Residence, and many have a kitchenette, good for both one-night travelers and long-stayers · What the reviews agree on is the cleanliness, the varied breakfast, and a location that saves both time and travel cost · Another selling point is the free shuttle van to Pattaya and Bang Saen, which makes Si Racha an easy base for getting around Chonburi · From the hotel you can also walk to Surasak Montri Park and Koh Loi Si Racha, good for an evening seaside stroll after shopping in the mall, and the estates or Laem Chabang port are within about 12 kilometers · Honest caveats: the pool is fairly small and in the building's shadow most of the day, so the water is cool and the sun barely reaches — better for a soak than serious swimming · Parking is limited when the hotel is full, and the building is classic rather than sharply modern · But if the heart of your trip is a location you can walk everywhere from on a low-four-figure budget, Pacific Park has almost no rival in this town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check the free Pattaya-Bang Saen shuttle schedule ahead since slots are limited · If you're driving, ask about parking first, since spaces are limited when it's full · Pick a room with a kitchenette if you want to save on food.
pros: Best location in town, attached to Robinson and Pacific Park, steps away
Many room types have a kitchenette, clean, varied breakfast (from reviews)
Free shuttle to Pattaya and Bang Saen, works as a base for getting around
Prices start in the low four figures, great value for the location · over 659 reviews
cons: Pool is small and in the building's shadow, water cool and little sun (from reviews)
Parking is limited when the hotel is full
Building is classic, not sharply modern

entries.name: Citadines Grand Central Sri Racha
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Surasak 1 Rd · 5 min walk to Robinson
entries.storyHtml: Citadines Grand Central Sri Racha is a serviced apartment under the Citadines brand (Ascott group) that draws particular praise for cleanliness and how spacious the rooms are, with an Agoda 9.0 from over 381 reviews · What sets it apart from the usual Si Racha serviced apartment is the international brand standard — rooms from Studio Deluxe up to a Two Bedroom Executive all have a kitchenette with cookware and a fridge, good for Laem Chabang workers, long-stayers, families, and Japanese guests in town for work alike · The highlight plenty of people mention is the pool and gym on the 8th-floor rooftop, with a sauna and jacuzzi and a Si Racha city view up top — a relaxing corner you don't often find at this price · The location is good too, about a 5 min walk to Robinson and Pacific Park, which makes finding food and supplies easy, and it's a short drive to the estates and Laem Chabang port, so Japanese guests and in-town workers pick it again and again · Honest caveats from the reviews: this is an in-town tower with a city view, not a resort you step straight down to the beach from — if your plan is to sleep right by the sea and swim, this isn't the answer · The car park is fairly tight when the hotel is full, and a few people felt the breakfast didn't have a lot of variety · If you want a big-brand serviced apartment with clean, spacious rooms and a kitchen plus a rooftop pool starting in the low four figures, Citadines is a tidy choice.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Head up to the 8th-floor rooftop pool and jacuzzi in the evening for the city view at sunset · For a long stay pick a room with a full kitchen, and if you're driving, arrive before evening since the car park gets tight when it's full.
pros: Ascott brand standard, rooms clean and very spacious, kitchen in every room
8th-floor rooftop pool and gym with sauna and jacuzzi, city view
Central location, 5 min walk to Robinson/Pacific Park
Prices start low, good for workers, long stays, families, and Japanese guests
cons: An in-town tower with a city view, not a resort you walk down to the beach from (from reviews)
Car park is fairly tight when the hotel is full
A few felt the breakfast didn't have much variety

entries.name: Balcony Courtyard Sriracha Hotel & Serviced Apartments
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.1 · Booking 9.0 · highest score on the list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Surasak · Si Racha · near the estates, has an onsen
entries.addr: 111/181 Moo 2, Si Racha-Nong Yai Bu Road, Surasak, Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: Balcony Courtyard Sriracha Hotel & Serviced Apartments is the highest-scoring stay in this article — Agoda 9.1 and Booking 9.0 · It's a large serviced apartment of 396 rooms in the Surasak area near the industrial estates, positioned as both a family hotel and a stay for workers · What the reviews agree on is the spacious serviced-apartment rooms with in-room kitchens, a clear split between bedroom and living room, and many rooms with a private balcony to catch the breeze · The standout facilities are a free Japanese-style onsen, a large outdoor pool, a small golf driving range, and kids' activities, so families coming in a group have plenty to do · Another big help is the free shuttle on several routes, both into town and to the estates, good for car-less guests here for work or training in the industrial zone · With as many as 396 rooms and large common areas, it comfortably handles both groups arriving together and families staying several nights, and there's an in-house restaurant so you don't have to go far on the nights you'd rather not travel · Honest caveats from the reviews: parts of the building are starting to show their age, the in-room Wi-Fi signal is weak in spots, especially rooms far from the access points, and the location has no eateries within walking distance, so you'll rely on a car or the shuttle · If you're here with family or for estate work and want big, home-like rooms with a kitchen plus an onsen and a shuttle on an attainable budget, this is the stay the reviews score highest on the list.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Use the free Japanese onsen and check the shuttle times into town and to the estates from check-in · If you have to work in the room, ask reception for one near a Wi-Fi access point · Pick a Luxury room if you want a kitchen and more space.
pros: Highest score on the list, Agoda 9.1 · Booking 9.0
Spacious serviced-apartment rooms with kitchens, clear bedroom-living split
Free Japanese onsen, large pool, and kids' activities, family-friendly
Free shuttle on several routes, good for car-less guests and estate workers
cons: Parts of the building are starting to show their age (from reviews)
In-room Wi-Fi is weak in spots, especially rooms far from the access points
Location has no eateries within walking distance, you'll rely on a car or shuttle

entries.type: 5-Star Hotel & Serviced Apartment · Walk to the Sea
entries.name: Cape Racha Hotel Sriracha
entries.badge: 🌊 5-star in town · rooftop pool with bay view
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Jerm Jompon Rd · central Si Racha, walk to the sea
tags: 🌊 Rooftop pool with Si Racha bay view
🏙️ In town, walk to the sea
entries.storyHtml: Cape Racha Hotel Sriracha is a 5-star hotel-serviced apartment in the Cape & Kantary Hotels group, set in central Si Racha on Jerm Jompon Road, with an Agoda 9.0 and a Booking 8.9 · Its strength is spacious rooms from a 46 sqm Deluxe Studio up to a two-bedroom suite with an in-room kitchen, good for both people who want a smart hotel room and those who want to cook for themselves over several nights · The highlight the reviews bring up often is the rooftop pool overlooking Si Racha bay with a sun deck — a corner that gives you a seaside feel without leaving · The breakfast is varied and the central location puts Robinson and the Koh Loi seafront within an easy walk · Among Si Racha stays, this is one of the few that carries a 5-star badge and is still within walking distance of the sea, so it suits couples after a nice atmosphere as well as workers who want a spacious room with a kitchen plus hotel-level service · Service under Cape & Kantary is a name Chonburi travelers have known and trusted for years · Honest caveats from the reviews: the building has been open since 2007, so some facilities are starting to age · Rooms in the annex don't feel on par with the main building and some are smaller than expected, so it's worth checking which building your room is in · If you want a spacious room with a kitchen, a central location within walking distance of the sea, and a pool with a bay view starting in the low two thousands, Cape Racha is a tidy choice.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a room in the main building when booking, since the reviews say the annex rooms don't feel the same · Head up to the rooftop pool in the evening for the Si Racha bay view, and pick a suite with a kitchen for a longer stay.
pros: 5-star in town, within walking distance of the sea and Robinson
Spacious rooms from a 46 sqm studio to suites with kitchens
Rooftop pool with a Si Racha bay view, and a varied breakfast
Cape & Kantary group, dependable service standard
cons: Building open since 2007, some facilities starting to age (from reviews)
Annex rooms don't feel on par with the main building
Some rooms smaller than expected, check which building the room is in

entries.name: Kantary Bay Hotel & Serviced Apartments Sriracha
entries.badge: 👨‍👩‍👧 Spacious rooms + kids' club · walk to the sea
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Jerm Jompon 1 · central Si Racha, walk to the seafront
tags: 🌊 Walk to the Koh Loi seafront
entries.storyHtml: Kantary Bay Hotel & Serviced Apartments Sriracha is a serviced apartment in the Cape & Kantary group, like Cape Racha, but positioned squarely as a family stay, with an Agoda 9.0 and a Booking 8.7 · What the reviews praise most is the very spacious suites with in-room kitchens, from a Studio Suite up to a Two Bedroom Suite that suits big families or long-stayers around Laem Chabang · The facilities are complete — pool, gym, sauna, mini golf, and a kids' club — so kids have things to do on-site · The location is central Si Racha, in Soi Jerm Jompon 1, within walking distance of the Koh Loi seafront and eateries · Service is to the Kantary-group standard plenty of people know and trust, with staff who help with calling cars, recommending eateries, and sorting out long stays · With rooms more spacious than a typical city hotel and a kitchen to cook in, many families driving down from Bangkok use it as a base for several nights and head out to Koh Loi, Si Racha market, and seafood eateries around town · It's also a great fit for people working around Laem Chabang who want a home-like stay within a short drive · Honest caveats from the reviews: this is an in-town tower, not a resort you step straight down to the beach from — if your plan is to sleep right by the beach, this isn't the answer · Parts of the building feel like they've seen some use, and there's some liveliness from the central-town setting on some nights · If you're here with family or for a long stay and want spacious rooms with a kitchen plus full kids' activities starting around two thousand, Kantary Bay is a dependable choice.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're bringing kids, pick a suite with a kitchen and make the most of the kids' club and mini golf · Ask for a higher floor or an inner-facing room if you're sensitive to street noise, and check the room you book has the kitchen you want.
pros: Very spacious suites with in-room kitchens, good for families and long stays
Complete facilities — pool, gym, sauna, mini golf, kids' club
Central location, walk to the Koh Loi seafront and eateries
Cape & Kantary group, dependable service standard
cons: An in-town tower, not a resort you walk down to the beach from (from reviews)
Parts of the building feel like they've seen some use
Some liveliness from the central-town setting on some nights

entries.name: Jasmine Resort Sriracha
entries.storyHtml: Jasmine Resort Sriracha is a resort that opened in 2024 in the Surasak area near the motorway, and it's become a popular stay thanks to how new it is and the spacious rooms at a low starting price, with an Agoda 8.9 from over 395 reviews · What draws people is the new, spacious 40–65 sqm rooms, with several types to choose from, Superior up to a Family Suite, good for families coming in a group · The facilities are complete — 2 pools and a kids' pool, a kids' club, and a hot-spring onsen — so you can relax on-site without going out · There's free parking and a free shuttle, and the quiet location near Robinson and the motorway suits people driving down from Bangkok who want a stay that's easy in and out without battling town traffic · What sets this resort apart from in-town serviced apartments is the genuine resort feel, with green space and pools for kids to run around — so families who want a weekend break without driving all the way to Pattaya pick it · Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a new resort, and the onsen cleanliness and consistency of service in spots are still settling in, with some reviews finding sediment in the onsen or leaves in the pool at times · And it's designed mainly for people with a car — there are no eateries within walking distance · If you want a new resort with spacious rooms, a pool, and an onsen with an entry-level room starting under a thousand, Jasmine is good value right now.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask about the onsen and pool cleaning schedule at check-in to avoid the window when the water isn't clear yet · Pick a room in the Malai building for the starting price, and bring a car or use the shuttle since there are no eateries within walking distance.
pros: Resort opened in 2024, new and spacious 40–65 sqm rooms
2 pools, kids' pool, kids' club, and a hot-spring onsen
Free parking and free shuttle, quiet location near the motorway
Low starting price, rooms from under a thousand, good value for a new resort
cons: Newly opened, onsen cleanliness and service in spots still settling in (from reviews)
Some reviews found sediment in the onsen or leaves in the pool at times
Designed for people with a car, no eateries within walking distance

entries.name: Madera Residence Sriracha
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thedsaban 1 Rd · in Si Racha town, near Pacific Park
tags: 🍳 Every room has a kitchenette + soaking tub
entries.storyHtml: Madera Residence Sriracha is an aparthotel in Si Racha town that's one of the most budget-friendly choices on the list, with rooms from around ฿900 and as many as over 1,562 reviews, a Booking 8.6 and an Agoda 8.5 · What brings people back is that every room has a kitchenette, a fridge, a microwave, and a soaking tub, at a price below many hotels in town, good for both people who want to cook for themselves and long-stayers · The property has a pool, a sauna, a gym, and free parking, and sits on Thedsaban 1 Road within walking distance of Pacific Park and Japanese restaurants, so it's convenient even without a car · It's a small property of around 50 rooms that's looked after thoroughly, with few staff who are friendly and helpful · The same neighborhood has Japanese restaurants, convenience stores, and a market within an easy walk for finding food, so long-stayers and in-town workers can use it as a regular stay easy on the wallet · What plenty of reviews are impressed by is the soaking tub in budget rooms, which you don't often find at this price · Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a small property, there's no full sea view, and some room types are inner rooms with no window or open view, so it's worth requesting a room with a window or balcony when booking · If you want a clean room with a kitchen and a soaking tub in Si Racha town on the tightest budget, plus a walk to the mall, Madera is good value with plenty of reviews to back it up.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a room with a window or balcony when booking, since some are inner rooms with no view · Pick a Suite with Balcony if you want more space and a balcony, and make the most of the kitchen and soaking tub that every room has.
pros: Among the most budget-friendly, rooms from around ฿900
Every room has a kitchenette, fridge, microwave, and soaking tub
Walk to Pacific Park and Japanese restaurants, has free parking
Lots of reviews, over 1,562, confirming the value
cons: A small property, no full sea view (from reviews)
Some room types are inner rooms with no window or open view
Worth requesting a room with a window or balcony when booking

entries.type: City Hotel · Managed by BBH Japan · Genuine Onsen
entries.name: The City Hotel Sriracha
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sukhumvit Rd, Surasak · central Si Racha
entries.addr: 6/126 Moo 2, Sukhumvit Road, Surasak, Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: The City Hotel Sriracha is a hotel that sells an authentic Japanese feel in central Si Racha, managed by BBH Japan (Breezbay), with an Agoda 8.6 and a Booking 8.5 from over 345 reviews · What brings Japanese guests and people who love a Japanese atmosphere back is the separate men's and women's onsen and the well-known Japanese breakfast, which give you the feel of staying at a hotel in Japan at Thai prices · The facilities are fuller than a typical city hotel — a pool, a gym, a spa, and even a tennis court · The location is on Sukhumvit Road in the Surasak area, near Pacific Park and Laem Chabang, good for in-town workers and travelers who want detail-minded Japanese service · Rooms come in several tiers from Superior up to a President Suite for those who want more space · What plenty of reviews mention is the overall atmosphere that feels like a business hotel in Japan, with polite, orderly staff, so Japanese guests working in the estates stay repeatedly and Thai guests who want to try an onsen without flying far come to use it too · Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a building that opened back in 1992 and was renovated in 2014, so some details are aging, the shower is fairly low, and water-pressure maintenance isn't consistent across every room · If you want a genuine onsen, a Japanese breakfast, and Japanese-style service in central Si Racha on an attainable budget, The City is the most distinctive choice on the list.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Make it in time for the Japanese breakfast plenty of reviews praise, and make the most of the separate men's-women's onsen · If you're sensitive to a building's age, ask for a recently renovated room and check the water pressure when you take the room · A Corner Suite gives you more space for the money.
pros: Separate men's-women's onsen and a well-known Japanese breakfast, authentic Japanese feel
Complete facilities — pool, gym, spa, tennis court
Managed by BBH Japan, detail-minded Japanese-style service
Central location near Pacific Park and Laem Chabang
cons: Building opened 1992, renovated 2014, some details aging (from reviews)
Shower is fairly low, water maintenance not consistent across every room
Better for those who set expectations on the Japanese character over newness

entries.type: City Hotel · Si Racha Bay View
entries.name: Arize Hotel Sri Racha
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sukhumvit Rd, Surasak · in town, Si Racha bay view
entries.addr: 8/88 Moo 4, Sukhumvit Road, Surasak, Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: Arize Hotel Sri Racha is a hillside hotel on Sukhumvit Road in the Surasak area that sells the draw of spacious rooms and a sea view on an attainable budget, with an Agoda 8.5 and a Booking 8.4 from over 534 reviews · What pulls people in is the 35–120 sqm rooms that are more spacious than the price suggests — many are Ocean View looking out over Si Racha bay, and the suites have an in-room kitchen, good for both couples after a view and families after space · There's a pool and gym on the 5th floor with a bay view, a nice spot to relax · The location is near Robinson, Laem Chabang, and within an easy drive of Pattaya, good as a base for getting around Chonburi · Because the building sits on a hillside, many higher-floor rooms look out over Si Racha bay and a pretty sunset — a spot the photo-minded reviews love — and the suites with kitchens suit families who want to cook on a longer trip · On a budget starting around thirteen hundred, getting a spacious room with a view like this isn't easy to find in this town · Honest caveats from the reviews: the consistency of service and housekeeping isn't as polished as the big chains, with some reviews finding dust or stains and inconsistent room care, so it's worth checking the room's condition when you take the key · The parking is open-air · If you want a spacious sea-view room in town starting around thirteen hundred and you set your expectations on polish accordingly, Arize gives you space and a view that's good value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request an Ocean View room directly to get a full Si Racha bay view, and check the room's cleanliness when you take the key · Pick a suite if you want a kitchen and more space.
pros: Spacious 35–120 sqm rooms, many with a Si Racha bay view, good value
Suites have in-room kitchens, good for couples and families
5th-floor pool and gym with a bay view · near Robinson and Laem Chabang
Attainable starting price, works as a base for getting around Chonburi
cons: Service consistency isn't as polished as the big chains (from reviews)
Some reviews found dust or stains, room care inconsistent
Parking is open-air

entries.name: Arin Hotel & Serviced Apartment (Karin Hotel)
entries.badge: 🇯🇵 Japanese style on the seafront · next to Samitivej
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Jerm Jompon Rd · seafront, next to Samitivej Sriracha Hospital
entries.storyHtml: Arin Hotel & Serviced Apartment (known as Karin Hotel) is a Japanese-style serviced apartment on the seafront in central Si Racha, with good scores on both Booking 8.9 and Agoda 8.6, even though the reviews aren't many yet at over 83 · What the reviews praise is the spacious studios with a kitchenette and beds imported from Japan, and the clean, simple Japanese décor that feels more like an apartment than a hotel, good for both long-stayers and travelers who want privacy · The highlight is the sky pool with a Gulf view and the seafront location on Jerm Jompon Road · Another handy point is that it sits next to Samitivej Sriracha Hospital and is within walking distance of Central Si Racha, good for people here for hospital visits or who want a stay near the mall · With not many rooms and the plain Japanese décor, the atmosphere is quieter and more private than a big hotel, good for people who want a fuss-free break or a long stay for in-town work · The Jerm Jompon Road location is also within walking distance of Si Racha's seafood eateries and seaside cafés, so it's convenient for eating, sightseeing, and errands alike · Honest caveats from the reviews: the facilities lean practical over luxurious · Some entry-level rooms have a city or partial view, so if you want a sea view you should request an Ocean View room · And around Si Racha town you'll still need a car for many places · If you want a Japanese-style studio with a kitchen on the seafront starting under a thousand, Arin is a quiet, private choice.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a Studio Ocean View or Premium Studio if you want a sea view, since some entry-level rooms have a city view · Head up to the sky pool in the evening for the Gulf view, and make the most of the in-room kitchen for a long stay.
pros: Spacious Japanese-style studios with kitchens, Japanese-imported beds, clean and simple
Sky pool with a Gulf view, seafront location in town
Next to Samitivej Sriracha Hospital, walk to Central Si Racha
Good scores on both sites, Booking 8.9 · Agoda 8.6 · prices from under a thousand
cons: Facilities lean practical over luxurious (from reviews)
Some entry-level rooms have a city or partial view
Around Si Racha town you'll still need a car for many places

entries.name: The Loft Seaside Sriracha Hotel
entries.badge: 🛁 Sea-view rooms with a balcony + bathtub
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Seafront, Soi Laem Ket · central Si Racha
tags: 🛁 Rooms with a balcony and bathtub
🚶 Walk to Koh Loi and eateries
entries.addr: 18 Soi Laem Ket, Jerm Jom Phon Road, Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: The Loft Seaside Sriracha Hotel is a loft-style seaside boutique hotel in central Si Racha in Soi Laem Ket, a choice that appeals to couples and travelers who want a sea-view room in the four-figure range, with an Agoda 8.5 and a Booking 8.3 from over 102 reviews · What pulls people in is the sea-view rooms with a balcony and an in-room bathtub, done in a cool exposed-concrete loft style, from Superior Sea View up to Loft Deluxe Sea View · There's a seafront pool looking out over Si Racha bay and a location within walking distance of Koh Loi, the viewpoint bridge, and seafront eateries · At 79 rooms, the atmosphere is compact and friendly, with staff who look after things thoroughly · What makes this a spot for social-media photos is the exposed-concrete-and-wood design that looks raw and cool against the sea view out front, so couples and café-hoppers stopping by Si Racha on a weekend like to stay · In the morning you sip coffee on the balcony watching the fishing boats in the bay, in the evening you walk to the Koh Loi bridge for the sunset — a nicely balanced break in the four-figure range · Honest caveats from the reviews: the front of the hotel is a seawall, not a sandy beach to swim at, so if you want to swim you use the hotel pool · The room walls are fairly thin so you hear the neighbors a bit, the building is starting to age since its 2017 renovation, and the service isn't consistent · If you're a couple or photo-minded and want a sea-view room with a balcony and a bathtub in the four-figure range, The Loft gives you an atmosphere that's good value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a Sea View room directly to get the balcony and bay view, since the Standard is a city view · Use the seafront pool instead of swimming in front of the hotel, and brace for the fairly thin room walls.
pros: Sea-view rooms with a balcony and an in-room bathtub, cool loft design
Seafront pool with a Si Racha bay view
Walk to Koh Loi, the viewpoint bridge, and seafront eateries
Prices from the four-figure range, good for couples and the photo-minded

entries.name: Laemtong Serviced Apartment
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Sukhumvit · central Si Racha, near Robinson
entries.storyHtml: Laemtong Serviced Apartment is a serviced apartment on Sukhumvit Road in central Si Racha, focused on value and a Japanese feel on a budget, with a Booking 8.3 and an Agoda 8.2 from over 214 reviews · What makes Laem Chabang workers and long-stayers choose it is the spacious rooms with in-room kitchens, a Japanese-style onsen, a pool, a gym, a sauna, and a sea view from higher-floor rooms at a price lower than many places in town · There's a free shuttle into town and a location near Robinson and Laem Chabang, convenient for both sightseeing and work · It suits travelers who like a classic, lived-in atmosphere · What makes workers stay regularly is that worked out by the month it's cheaper than many places, with a kitchen, an onsen, and a sea view all in one spot, plus a walk to in-town eateries and the market · The overall feel is more like an apartment with hotel facilities than a beach resort, which is right for the long-stay crowd · Honest caveats from the reviews: this is an on-Sukhumvit tower in town, not a resort you step straight down to the beach from · The building and décor feel classic and well-used, the mattress is fairly firm, and there are small details worth knowing before booking · If you want a room with a kitchen plus an onsen and a sea view in town starting around twelve hundred and you're fine with a classic-style building, Laemtong is good value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a higher floor for the sea view and make the most of the onsen and the free shuttle into town · If you're sensitive to mattress firmness, ask about an extra bed or pick a recently updated room, and set your expectations on the classic-style building.

entries.storyHtml: Capetown Sriracha Residence is a Japanese-themed condo-residence in the Surasak area that has the most reviews in this article, over 1,773, with an Agoda 8.3 and a Booking 8.2 · This place suits people who want to "live" in Si Racha more than "visit" for a short stretch · What makes estate workers and long-stayers choose it is rooms with a kitchenette and a warm soaking tub, a 20-meter pool, and free parking at a price that's good value worked out per day for a multi-night stay · The location is near J-Park Nihon Mura, Si Racha's popular Japanese shopping and dining spot, so finding Japanese food is easy — it's like living in Si Racha's Little Tokyo · The warm soaking tub in the room and the 20-meter pool are what long-stayers say help them unwind after work, and worked out per day for a weekly or monthly stay it's very good value compared with a nightly hotel · Many reviews are from people who came back to stay again or stayed on for several months · Honest caveats from the reviews: this is a condo-residence building with many owners renting out units, so the standard varies room to room — some are nicely done, some plainer, so it's worth looking closely at the photos and reviews of the room you book · And the building is in town, not on the beach, geared more to real living than a holiday break · If you're here for estate work or a long stay and want a room with a kitchen and a soaking tub near the Japanese district at a price that's good value per day, Capetown has the most reviews to back it up.

entries.storyHtml: Sriracha Orchid is an aparthotel in the Si Racha old town on Surasak 3 Road that closes the list as a budget choice for people who want a spacious room in town on a low budget, with an Agoda 7.8 and a Booking 7.7 from over 178 reviews · What makes people choose it is the several room types with a kitchenette and a fridge, especially the roughly 55 sqm duplex loft room that's bigger than the price suggests, good for families or groups of friends who want space on a budget · The location is within walking distance of the market and the Si Racha clock tower, where you get the old-town atmosphere and local food · There's free parking and a shuttle to the Koh Sichang pier, good for people heading on by boat to the islands · The old-town setting also has the charm of walking out to noodle shops, old coffee houses, and local food at everyday prices, so people who want a more traditional Si Racha than the modern malls like to stay around here · For budget travelers who care about space and a walkable location over luxury, the loft rooms here give some of the best space-per-baht in town · Honest caveats from the reviews: it's an old building that's been renovated, the paintwork is peeling in spots, the bed is fairly hard, and the indoor pool isn't looked after consistently · This isn't a stay for people expecting a brand-new, flawless room, but if you want a spacious room with a kitchen in the old town starting around ฿900 and a way to carry on by boat to Koh Sichang, Sriracha Orchid is a tidy choice for budget travelers.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a Duplex Loft if you want the most space for the money · If you're heading to Koh Sichang, ask about the pier shuttle times ahead, and set your expectations on a renovated old building — it's about space and location over newness.

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room range and may change by date and season — we recommend checking real prices and comparing 3 sites before every booking · The scores and highlights in this article come from reading guests' real reviews on the booking platforms (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com); we didn't stay ourselves · Si Racha is a port-and-industrial seaside city, where most stays are serviced apartments with kitchens rather than beachfront resorts, and the sea in front of town is a viewpoint seawall rather than a sandy beach for swimming · Over long holidays and festivals prices rise and rooms sell out fast, so book ahead · Si Racha has no train line — use your own car or Grab; from Bangkok it's about an hour and a half down the motorway · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — Common questions travelers ask about Si Racha stays

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best Si Racha stay?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style · If you're with family and want seafront with kids' activities, Centara Sonrisa Residences & Suites has a water park, kids' club, onsen, and the most reviews at over 1,310 · If you have no car and want to walk to everything, Pacific Park Hotel is attached to Robinson, steps away · If you want a brand-standard serviced apartment with a kitchen, Citadines Grand Central is in the Ascott group · And if you measure by score alone, Balcony Courtyard has an Agoda 9.1 · Booking 9.0, the highest on the list

faq.q: ❓ How much do Si Racha stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start around ฿900–2,100 per night for a standard room · The most budget-friendly are Madera, Sriracha Orchid, Arin, and The Loft Seaside, from around ฿900 · Mid-range are Pacific Park, Citadines, Arize, around ฿1,000–1,500 · And the highest on the list are Cape Racha ฿2,100, Kantary Bay ฿1,900, and Balcony Courtyard ฿1,800 · All prices are approximate starting rates, and over long holidays they may be higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ Do Si Racha stays have a beach for swimming?
faq.a: Most don't · The sea in front of Si Racha town is a seafront seawall and viewpoint bridge (Koh Loi) rather than a sandy beach for swimming · Seafront stays like The Loft Seaside, Arin, and Centara Sonrisa focus on the bay view and the hotel pool instead of swimming in front of the stay · If you want a real sandy beach to swim at, you should drive on to Bang Saen or Pattaya, which aren't far

faq.q: ❓ What kind of Si Racha stay suits estate workers and long stays?
faq.a: A serviced apartment with an in-room kitchen suits best · Capetown Sriracha Residence (near J-Park Nihon Mura), Citadines Grand Central, Kantary Bay, Madera Residence, and Laemtong all have a kitchenette, a fridge, and many have an onsen, good for both Laem Chabang workers and people staying several nights · Many have free parking and a shuttle into town

faq.q: ❓ Why does Si Racha have so many onsen and Japanese-style stays?
faq.a: Because Si Racha and Laem Chabang are home to industrial estates with a large Japanese community working here, so Japanese restaurants, onsen, and Japanese-style stays are scattered all over town · On this list, The City Hotel (managed by BBH Japan, separate men's-women's onsen), Balcony Courtyard, Jasmine Resort, Laemtong, and Arin Hotel all have an onsen or a Japanese touch to experience

faq.q: ❓ How do you get from Bangkok to Si Racha · and how far ahead should you book?
faq.a: From Bangkok it's about an hour and a half down the motorway, or you can take a shuttle van/coach from Ekkamai and Mo Chit · Si Racha has no train line; in town your own car or Grab is most convenient, and many hotels have a free shuttle · On booking: on regular days 1–2 weeks ahead is enough, but over long holidays and festivals you should book 3–4 weeks ahead or more, especially seafront stays and family resorts · Every platform has Free Cancellation — we recommend locking in a rate like that first, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
